question.text: The MINIMUM corpus required for a scheme of a Cat III AIF (e.g., Nilgiri Multi-Strategy Fund) is:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI (AIF) Regulations 2012, Regulation 10(d) requires every scheme of an AIF to have a minimum corpus of INR 20 crore. This applies across Cat I, II and III. The Trap: INR 5 cr and INR 10 cr are common distractor numbers from sponsor commit rules (INR 10 cr Cat III sponsor floor), not scheme corpus. INR 50 cr is fabricated. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B/C/D all test this INR 20 crore corpus floor — it's a stable regulatory constant. Manager's Pro-Tip: If your scheme is slow to build corpus, launch with a phased first-close at INR 20 cr and add tranches later — don't breach the floor by launching early to lock a market window.
